WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ip.person_email AS email,
    ip.person_name AS name,
    d.term_code,
    d.fee,
    CASE
      WHEN d.term_code IS NULL OR length(d.term_code) < 6 THEN NULL
      WHEN upper(substr(d.term_code, 5, 2)) = 'FA' THEN CAST(substr(d.term_code, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)

# Inclusive per-person per-academic-year aggregates from detail + person; infer academic_year from term_code using SQL.
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ip.person_email AS email,
    ip.person_name AS name,
    d.term_code,
    d.fee,
    CASE
      WHEN d.term_code IS NULL OR length(d.term_code) < 6 THEN NULL
      WHEN upper(substr(d.term_code, 5, 2)) = 'FA' THEN CAST(substr(d.term_code, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(substr(d.term_code, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 1
    END AS academic_year
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person ip
    ON d.iap_subject_person_key = ip.iap_subject_person_key
  WHERE d.term_code IS NOT NULL
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    email,
    name,
    academic_year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_iap_subjects,
    MIN(fee) AS min_fee,
    MAX(fee) AS max_fee
  FROM base
  GROUP BY email, name, academic_year
)
SELECT 
  email,
  name,
  academic_year,
  total_iap_subjects,
  min_fee,
  max_fee,
  total_iap_subjects AS total_course_enrollment
FROM agg
WHERE academic_year IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY academic_year DESC NULLS LAST, name
LIMIT 50
"""

db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
